description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/sec/xbrl-frames (base $0.02; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?concept=Revenues&period=CY2024 (optional taxonomy, unit, limit 1-500, offset, order=desc|asc). XBRL frames: one XBRL concept for one calendar period, with one value per company that reported it (latest filed fact closest to the period, standard taxonomies only), sorted by value, with CIK, company, period end and accession number. Values are as reported by each company and may later be amended; reporting periods may not match the calendar exactly. USDC on Base only. Bad input: Not charged. Data from SEC EDGAR; not affiliated with or endorsed by the SEC. Not investment advice.
